input.prompt: Extreme close-up of her eyes, wide awake and unblinking: reflections of orange and red/blue light trails slide smoothly across her irises and the glossy eye surface from one side to the other; a faint rhythmic heartbeat tremor. Locked-off camera, eyes stay exactly the same size. Anime style, consistent with the first frame, clean cel shading, same character design: same face, same large eyes (same size, never smaller), same long straight black hair, same white cropped jacket with orange bands and patches, black top and trousers; no glasses. Smooth, stable lineart, no morphing, correct hands with five fingers. Single continuous shot, no cuts. No text, no subtitles, no logos.
